=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2031-2037 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The ceiling guard in review_phase_deadline_extension_allowed reserves only POLL_INTERVAL, so a poll admitted just before the ceiling can overrun it through gh API retry backoff and request time.
  WHY: The overrun consumes time reserved for later release phases. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT (confidence 2, rare, bounded, small against the reserves); the others rated it MAJOR. The highest severity is used.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:review_phase_deadline_extension_allowed() | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The extension logic bypasses the inactivity and current-step duration guards for review runs in queued, pending, waiting or requested states.
  WHY: A run stuck in a non-active state could keep Phase 4 extended up to the ceiling instead of ending on inactivity. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 examined this and rejected it, because such runs have no steps or activity to measure and the ceiling still bounds the wait.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:review_phase_deadline_extension_allowed() NOW check | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The [[ "$now" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] check does not cover NOW being empty or non-numeric, and the function then returns 1.
  WHY: A bad NOW would end Phase 4 early. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 examined this and rejected it, because NOW is assigned from date +%s just before the check.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:~2010-2050, ~2231-2250 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: When the extension is granted through REVIEW_PHASE_HANDOFF_PENDING, RUN_ID and RUN_STATUS still describe the dropped run, so the E2E_REVIEW_DEADLINE_EXTENDED log line names the wrong run.
  WHY: The log line is misleading to anyone grepping it. The wait logic and the ceiling are unaffected.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
(No task gaps reported.)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2031-2037 | severity=nit | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The ceiling guard reserves only POLL_INTERVAL (10 s), but the poll that follows makes gh_api_safe_quiet_print calls that can retry. A poll admitted just before the ceiling can overrun it.
  WHY: This only matters if a rate-limit or transient failure hits in the last seconds before the ceiling. The overrun is small next to the ceiling reserves, the 300-minute job timeout still holds, and a later poll is rechecked against the ceiling.
(Three pass-1 findings from other reviewers were checked and rejected: the queued/pending bypass of idle and step-age checks, NOW not being an integer, and a stale handoff flag.)
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:review_phase_deadline_extension_allowed() | severity=major | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The deadline extension logic bypasses the inactivity and current-step duration limits for review runs in queued, pending, waiting or requested states.
  WHY: A run that stays in a non-active state indefinitely lets Phase 4 extend to the ceiling instead of ending on inactivity.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:review_phase_deadline_extension_allowed() ceiling guard | severity=major | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The ceiling guard accounts only for POLL_INTERVAL, not for the poll's request time and rate-limit retries.
  WHY: An API request admitted near the ceiling can spend up to 210 seconds in retries plus request time, pushing Phase 4 past the total wall-clock budget.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:review_phase_deadline_extension_allowed() NOW check | severity=major | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: [[ "$now" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] does not account for NOW being empty or non-numeric because of a misconfigured environment.
  WHY: If NOW is not a valid integer, the function returns 1 early and Phase 4 may time out prematurely.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:~2010-2050, ~2231-2250 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When the extension is granted through REVIEW_PHASE_HANDOFF_PENDING, RUN_ID and RUN_STATUS still describe the dropped run, so the E2E_REVIEW_DEADLINE_EXTENDED log line names the dropped run instead of its successor.
  WHY: The log attribution is misleading, but the wait logic and the ceiling are unaffected.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:review_phase_deadline_extension_allowed (~line 2014) and the following gh pr view / gh run list calls | severity=major | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The ceiling guard reserves only POLL_INTERVAL, not the time the poll itself takes. An iteration admitted at CEILING - POLL_INTERVAL can run past the ceiling.
  WHY: The overrun consumes the reserve held for Phase 4b, Phase 6, Phase 7 and finalization. The hardening suggestion adds a fixed API-call budget of about 300 s to the margin (about 6 lines, hardening risk score 3).
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2031-2036 and 2378; retry logic in scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh:121-147 | severity=major | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The ceiling check accounts for POLL_INTERVAL but not the time spent fetching and processing the poll. The review-run API request can retry rate-limit failures with 30-, 60- and 120-second waits.
  WHY: A poll admitted shortly before the ceiling can spend more than its 10 s interval in retries, so Phase 4 continues past the ceiling and consumes time reserved for later release phases.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
